name: Feeds Instagram
description: Fetches Instagram media via the Facebook/Meta Graph API for Feeds.
project_description:
Instagram fetcher/parser for the Feeds module.

 This module requires an Instagram Business Account connected to a Facebook page which you have admin permissions for. The Instagram Graph API Getting Started page has a broad overview of how this module works, specifically steps 1-2 must be completed in order to connect your Instagram Business Account.

 Supported data from imported feeds: 
 
 id 
 instagram_id 
 shortcode 
 published_datetime 
 published_timestamp 
 type 
 media_url 
 thumbnail_url 
 caption 
 title 
 permalink 
 like_count 
 comments_count 
 owner_id 
 username 
 is_comment_enabled 
 children 
 comments
